# Anthropic — Style Reference

> Unbleached letterpress stock, with color pasted in as collage. A bold grotesk hands off to a bookish serif on #faf9f5 paper, hairlines are drawn in #dedcd1, and the only accent is near-black ink.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Anthropic speaks a warm-paper editorial language. A #faf9f5 canvas carries #f5f4ed linen for cards, pills and the full-bleed feature band, #e8e6dc parchment for secondary fills, and #141413 ink for text, the primary-button fill and the entire footer field. The interface's chromatic budget is zero: all 11 measured colors are warm neutrals with a faint yellow cast, and saturated hue is allowed only inside collage illustrations and photographs. Typography carries the hierarchy. anthropicSans at 400 accounts for 61 of 72 text samples, 700 marks 22px card titles, and the 48px hero switches from a semibold sans clause to a regular serif in the middle of a sentence, tracked at -0.01em. The shape vocabulary is pill-and-soft: 9999px navigation pills, 10px buttons, 16px cards and square-cut 0px images. Elevation is purely tonal, with zero box-shadows measured anywhere on the page. The site reads as a research publisher's reading room rather than a software vendor's landing page.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paper Canvas | `#faf9f5` | `--color-paper-canvas` | Body background behind the hero and Learn more grid, plus reversed text on ink (9 uses). This warm off-white removes the clinical glare of pure white. |
| Linen Surface | `#f5f4ed` | `--color-linen-surface` | Announcement cards, the full-bleed feature band, nav pills and light inputs (18 uses). It is the workhorse surface and sits one tonal step above the canvas. |
| Parchment Fill | `#e8e6dc` | `--color-parchment-fill` | Secondary button fill, ellipsis meta pills and pill borders (10 fills, 10 borders). It is the deepest light tone and signals "pressable" without any hue. |
| Carbon Panel | `#262624` | `--color-carbon-panel` | Dark search input and inverted panels inside the ink footer and menu (9 uses). It lifts controls off the ink field tonally rather than with an outline. |
| Ink | `#141413` | `--color-ink` | Headlines, card titles, the primary-button fill and the whole footer field (17 text uses). This warm near-black is the system's only "accent". Do not dilute it into gray for CTAs. |
| Graphite Ink | `#30302e` | `--color-graphite-ink` | Card body copy and secondary-button labels (6 uses). It is softer than Ink, so card text reads as content rather than as a heading. |
| Charcoal Nav | `#3d3d3a` | `--color-charcoal-nav` | Nav-pill and icon-button labels (6 uses) and every hairline on the ink footer (18 borders). It is the dark-side divider and the chrome voice. |
| Slate Caption | `#5e5d59` | `--color-slate-caption` | Lead paragraphs, meta labels such as "Announcements" and dates (21 uses, the most frequent text color). Long-form reading runs here, not in Ink. |
| Pebble Meta | `#87867f` | `--color-pebble-meta` | Tertiary text: footer links, secondary meta and inline "View" affordances (11 uses). It recedes on both paper and ink. Do not use it for body paragraphs. |
| Ash Footnote | `#b0aea5` | `--color-ash-footnote` | Copyright line and the faintest footer annotations (2 uses). It is the floor of the text ramp. Do not use it on #f5f4ed, where contrast collapses. |
| Sand Border | `#dedcd1` | `--color-sand-border` | List-row dividers, the Learn more rule and secondary-button outlines (17 uses). These 1px hairlines replace every shadow the system declines to use. |

## Tokens — Typography

### anthropicSans — the UI, body and display grotesk that carries almost every glyph on the page · `--font-anthropic-sans`

- **Substitute:** DM Sans at 400 body / 700 titles, Figtree at 400 / 700, Instrument Sans at 400 / 600. anthropicSans draws slightly wider and heavier than its nominal weight, so its 600 renders close to a conventional 650. For the 61px display, DM Sans at 700 matches stroke thickness better than DM Sans at 600.
- **Weights:** 400, 600, 700
- **Sizes:** 11px, 13px, 15px, 17px, 22px, 48px, 61px
- **Line height:** 1.08 (61px), 1.25 (22px, 48px), 1.5 (11px, 15px), 1.53 (17px), 1.54 (13px)
- **Letter spacing:** 0.2px at 11px, 0.13px at 13px, 0px at 15px, 17px, 22px and 61px, -0.48px at 48px
- **OpenType features:** `"liga"`, `"lnum"`, `"pnum"`
- **Role:** Weight 400 does 85% of the work (61 of 72 samples), which deliberately lets 700 at 22px read as a headline without any size theatrics. The small steps of 13 → 15 → 17px sit at roughly 1.13, which is tighter than a Minor Third. The scale then leaps 2.18× from 22px to 48px, skipping the middle headings that convention would fill in. Positive tracking at 11px and 13px opens the micro-labels, and the lining proportional figures keep dates such as "Oct 7, 2026" aligned without looking tabular.

### anthropicSerif — the editorial voice that finishes the hero sentence · `--font-anthropic-serif`

- **Substitute:** Source Serif 4 at 400 (display optical size), Newsreader at 450, Literata at 400. anthropicSerif is a sturdy transitional text face that draws heavier than Newsreader's 400, so step that substitute up.
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 48px
- **Line height:** 1.25
- **Letter spacing:** -0.48px at 48px
- **OpenType features:** `"liga"`, `"lnum"`, `"pnum"`
- **Role:** The serif appears in 1 of 72 measured samples, which makes it punctuation rather than decoration. It picks up the hero sentence after the sans clause ends, so the shift from claim to explanation happens through typeface rather than through size or color. Its -0.01em tracking matches the sans at the same size, and that keeps the handoff seamless on a single baseline.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | anthropicSans | 400 | 11px | 1.5 | 0.2px | `--text-small` |
| caption | anthropicSans | 400 | 13px | 1.54 | 0.13px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | anthropicSans | 400 | 15px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | anthropicSans | 400 | 17px | 1.53 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| heading-sm | anthropicSans | 700 | 22px | 1.25 | 0px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading-lg | — | — | 48px | 1.25 | -0.48px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | anthropicSans | 600 | 61px | 1.08 | 0px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Keep every interface surface, label and control inside the warm-neutral ramp from #faf9f5 to #141413. The zero-hue budget is non-negotiable, and saturated color enters only through illustration.
- Write the hero as one sentence: a 48px anthropicSans weight 600 clause, then the remainder in anthropicSerif weight 400 at the same size and -0.48px tracking. The switch of typeface is the hierarchy.
- Set reading copy at 17px weight 400 in #5e5d59 with 1.53 line height and a 616px measure. Reserving #141413 for titles keeps the two text tones meaningful.
- Separate cards from the page by tone alone: #f5f4ed at 16px radius on #faf9f5, with no border and no shadow. A 1-step surface shift is the system's entire elevation model.
- Divide list rows with 1px #dedcd1 hairlines and 16px vertical padding. The ruled-ledger look replaces boxed sub-cards.
- Give navigation 9999px pills at 28px height, and give content actions 10px rectangles. Two radii make two grammars: index tabs versus commands.
- Use weight 700 only at 22px titles and 13px section labels, and weight 600 only at 48px and 61px. Bold is rationed to 10 of 72 samples so it keeps its force.

### Don't

- Promoting a brand hue such as clay orange (#d97757, not a system token on this page) to the primary button breaks the thesis that the interface is colorless. The single ink slab at #141413 is the only accent, and color belongs to the collages.
- Adding box-shadows to the 16px announcement cards contradicts a page that measures zero shadows. Lifted cards turn a printed broadsheet into a dashboard.
- Swapping the canvas for pure white (#ffffff, not a system token) strips the yellow cast from #faf9f5. The warm-paper feel collapses into generic SaaS.
- Rounding the Learn more images to 16px to match the cards erases the deliberate 0px plate edge. The illustrations stop reading as printed art.
- Setting paragraphs in #141413 because "black is more readable" flattens the hierarchy. Body copy at #5e5d59 is what lets 22px weight 700 titles stand out without growing.
- Filling the 22px-to-48px gap with 28px, 32px and 36px headings dilutes the deliberate 2.18× leap. The page needs exactly two headline tiers.
- Never set anthropicSerif below 22px or use it for buttons and labels. At 1 of 72 samples it is a hero-only voice, and spreading it turns punctuation into wallpaper.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #faf9f5 (Paper Canvas)
- card surface: #f5f4ed (Linen Surface)
- secondary fill: #e8e6dc (Parchment Fill)
- primary text: #141413 (Ink)
- body text: #5e5d59 (Slate Caption)
- hairline: #dedcd1 (Sand Border)
- primary action: #141413 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and bars stay neutral-only, built from the ramp #141413, #5e5d59, #87867f, #b0aea5 and #dedcd1 on #faf9f5, with the highlighted series in solid #141413 and comparison series in #87867f. Saturated hue is not used in data, so no visualization outshouts the collage illustrations.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor with background #141413, text #faf9f5, a 1px solid #141413 border, border-radius 10px, padding 12px 24px and a height of 36px, set in anthropicSans (fallback DM Sans) at 17px, weight 400, line-height 1.53, letter-spacing 0px, with no box-shadow. On hover, shift the background to #30302e and keep the border matched to the fill. Place at most one per viewport, and pair it with a secondary button using background #e8e6dc, text #30302e, a 1px #dedcd1 border, the same 10px radius and padding 12px 20px 12px 24px.

2. Build a sticky Navigation Bar 84px tall with a transparent background over a #faf9f5 page, a 1920px max-width container and 80px horizontal padding. Lay it out in three flex zones. On the left, four pills (News, Research, Policy, Commitments), each with background #f5f4ed, text #3d3d3a, a 1px #e8e6dc border, border-radius 9999px, padding 8px 12px 8px 16px, a 28px height and 13px weight 400 anthropicSans with 0.13px letter-spacing, plus a 12px chevron, all separated by 8px gaps. In the center, a 170px × 24px wordmark in #141413. On the right, two more pills followed by two 28px × 28px icon buttons with radius 8px, padding 8px, background #f5f4ed and a 1px #e8e6dc border. Use no shadow and no bottom border.

3. Build an Announcement Card: an article with background #f5f4ed, border-radius 16px, padding 32px, no border and no shadow, placed in a three-column grid with 16px gaps on #faf9f5. Inside it, add a meta row with an 8px gap: a 36px × 18px pill (background #e8e6dc, 1px #dedcd1 border, radius 9999px, three-dot glyph in #30302e), then "Announcements" and a date at 13px weight 400 in #5e5d59 with 0.13px tracking. Below it, add a 22px weight 700 #141413 title with line-height 1.25, 8px below the meta row, then a 15px weight 400 #30302e summary with line-height 1.5. Push two rows to the bottom, each with 16px vertical padding and a 1px #dedcd1 top border, showing a 15px #141413 label on the left and a 15px #87867f value with an arrow on the right. End with a full-width secondary button (background #e8e6dc, text #30302e, 1px #dedcd1 border, radius 10px, padding 12px 20px 12px 24px, 17px weight 400).

4. Build a Hero Statement: a single h1 on #faf9f5 with a 1745px max width, 80px side gutters and 80px of space below. Start the sentence in a span of anthropicSans (fallback DM Sans at 700) at 48px, weight 600, color #141413, and continue the same sentence in anthropicSerif (fallback Source Serif 4 at 400) at 48px, weight 400, color #141413. Use line-height 1.25 and letter-spacing -0.48px on both spans. Add no image, background, border or shadow. The change of typeface mid-sentence is the only emphasis device.

## Tokens — Spacing & Shapes

**Base unit:** 4px

**Density:** comfortable

### Spacing Scale

| Name | Value | Token |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 2px | `--spacing-2` |
| 4 | 4px | `--spacing-4` |
| 8 | 8px | `--spacing-8` |

### Border Radius

| Element | Value |
|---|---|
| cards | 16px |
| pills | 9999px |
| buttons | 10px |
| inputs | 8px |
| badges | 9999px |
| smallElements | 8px |
| smallCards | 4px |
| images | 0px |

### Layout

- **Page max-width:** 1920px (616–1920px)
- **Section gap:** 80px (80–224px)
- **Card padding:** 32px
- **Element gap:** 16px (8–16px)

## Components

### Nav Pill — Dropdown Trigger

**Role:** Top-level navigation and menu disclosure

A quiet capsule control. It uses a #f5f4ed background, #3d3d3a text, a 1px #e8e6dc border, 9999px radius (measured as 999999px and normalized), 8px 12px 8px 16px padding with a trailing chevron (8px 16px when there is no chevron), 28px height, and anthropicSans at 13px weight 400 with 0.13px tracking, with no shadow. The pill shape is reserved for navigation chrome, so the nav reads as a row of index tabs rather than as buttons asking to be pressed.

### Icon Square Button

**Role:** Search and menu glyph triggers

A compact square sibling of the nav pill. It is 28px × 28px with 8px padding, a #f5f4ed background, a #3d3d3a glyph, a 1px #e8e6dc border, 8px radius and no shadow. At 36px × 36px with 10px radius it becomes the carousel pause control. The radius shift from 9999px to 8px is intentional: an icon-only target reads as a tool rather than a destination.

### Navigation Bar

**Role:** Sticky masthead with centered wordmark

A transparent, centered masthead. The bar is sticky and 84px tall, with no fill of its own, so it sits directly on the #faf9f5 canvas. Four nav pills sit on the left (News, Research, Policy, Commitments), the #141413 wordmark is centered at 170px × 24px, and two pills plus two 28px icon squares sit on the right, separated by 8px gaps with 80px page gutters. The symmetrical split is anti-convention, since most SaaS headers align the logo left. Centering the wordmark makes the bar read like a newspaper masthead.

### Primary Button — Ink Fill

**Role:** The single filled call to action

The only filled button in the system. It uses a #141413 background, #faf9f5 text, a 1px #141413 border, 10px radius, 12px 24px padding, a 36px measured height, and anthropicSans at 17px weight 400, with no shadow. Weight 400 on a filled CTA runs against convention: the ink slab supplies all the emphasis, so the label does not need bold. Use one per view, because in a zero-hue system this black rectangle is the loudest object on the page.

### Secondary Button — Parchment Fill

**Role:** In-card read-more action

A full-width tonal bar. It uses a #e8e6dc background, #30302e text with a trailing arrow, a 1px #dedcd1 border, 10px radius, 12px 20px 12px 24px padding, a 36px height and the full 507px card content width, set in anthropicSans at 17px weight 400 with no shadow. It sits one step darker than the #f5f4ed card it lives on, so it signals action through tone rather than contrast. That makes it the workhorse for repeated card actions.

### Announcement Card

**Role:** Model release summary tile

A borderless linen slab. It uses a #f5f4ed background, no border, 16px radius, 32px padding, a 571px × 426px footprint in a three-up grid with 16px gutters, and no shadow. The stack runs from a meta row (ellipsis pill, 13px #5e5d59 category and date) to a 22px weight 700 #141413 title, a 15px #30302e summary, two 1px #dedcd1 divided rows ("Model Details", "System Card") and the parchment button. Separation comes entirely from the 1-step tonal shift against #faf9f5.

### Meta Pill — Ellipsis Tag

**Role:** Category marker before labels

A tiny tonal lozenge. It is 36px × 18px with a #e8e6dc fill, #30302e glyphs, a 1px #dedcd1 border, 9999px radius, zero padding, and anthropicSans at 13px with a 1.15 line height, and it holds a three-dot glyph. It prefixes every card category and every Learn more label, working as a typographic bullet that marks taxonomy without spending a color. Treat it as ornament, not as a control.

### Hero Statement — Split Typeface

**Role:** Mission sentence as headline

A single sentence in two voices. The first clause is anthropicSans at 48px weight 600, and the remainder continues in anthropicSerif at 48px weight 400, both #141413, with 1.25 line height and -0.48px tracking, running 1745px wide across three lines on #faf9f5 with no container, border or shadow. The handoff from grotesk to serif is the signature typographic move: the sans states the claim and the serif delivers the reasoning, with no size change between them.

### Feature Carousel Band

**Role:** Rotating pillar spotlight

A full-bleed linen stage. It uses a #f5f4ed background, 224px vertical padding (the largest spacing value measured), a centered square photograph at 0px radius, and a caption card beneath it with a #faf9f5 fill, a 1px #e8e6dc border and 4px radius (estimated assignment). The caption holds a 15px #30302e "Pillar" label with #87867f context and a serif headline, and a 36px pause control sits bottom-right. The band is the system outlier in scale, since 224px is 2.8× the standard 80px section gap. It is allowed because the band works as an exhibition plinth.

### Section Rule Header

**Role:** Labels an editorial grid

A hairline-bracketed label. The text is anthropicSans at 13px weight 700 in #141413 with 0.13px tracking, set between 1px #dedcd1 rules with 16px 0 padding across the full 1745px content width, with no fill and no radius. Running the label at 13px bold rather than at the expected 32px or larger section heading is deliberately anti-convention. It reads as a table-of-contents entry and lets the illustrated tiles below carry the visual weight.

### Editorial Image Tile

**Role:** Learn more four-up entry

A square-cut plate with a caption. It holds a meta pill and a 13px #5e5d59 label, then an image at 424px × 530px with 0px radius, no border and no shadow, then a 22px weight 700 #141413 title and a 13px #5e5d59 description. Tiles sit in four columns with 16px gutters on #faf9f5. The 0px image radius is the deliberate exception to a rounded system: the collages read as printed plates tipped into a book, not as app thumbnails.

### Search Input — Light and Inverted

**Role:** Site search field

A slim rounded field. The light variant uses a #f5f4ed background, #141413 text, a 1px #e8e6dc border and 8px radius. The inverted variant uses a #262624 background, #faf9f5 text and a 1px #3d3d3a border. Both are 352px × 30px with 0px 16px 0px 36px padding (leaving room for a leading glyph), set in anthropicSans at 13px weight 400, with no shadow. The two variants share geometry and swap only tone, which shows how the system inverts without redesigning.

### Footer — Ink Accordion

**Role:** Sitemap, mission and sign-in

An ink field with ruled rows. It uses a #141413 background at full 1905px width, 628px tall, with a #faf9f5 wordmark on the left. A central accordion of nine rows at 13px #87867f is separated by 1px #3d3d3a hairlines with chevrons. A right column holds "Our mission" in #faf9f5 with #87867f body text, and the left foot carries an #b0aea5 copyright. It is the only inverted surface, and it closes the page the way a back cover closes a book.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Keep every interface surface, label and control inside the warm-neutral ramp from #faf9f5 to #141413. The zero-hue budget is non-negotiable, and saturated color enters only through illustration.
- Write the hero as one sentence: a 48px anthropicSans weight 600 clause, then the remainder in anthropicSerif weight 400 at the same size and -0.48px tracking. The switch of typeface is the hierarchy.
- Set reading copy at 17px weight 400 in #5e5d59 with 1.53 line height and a 616px measure. Reserving #141413 for titles keeps the two text tones meaningful.
- Separate cards from the page by tone alone: #f5f4ed at 16px radius on #faf9f5, with no border and no shadow. A 1-step surface shift is the system's entire elevation model.
- Divide list rows with 1px #dedcd1 hairlines and 16px vertical padding. The ruled-ledger look replaces boxed sub-cards.
- Give navigation 9999px pills at 28px height, and give content actions 10px rectangles. Two radii make two grammars: index tabs versus commands.
- Use weight 700 only at 22px titles and 13px section labels, and weight 600 only at 48px and 61px. Bold is rationed to 10 of 72 samples so it keeps its force.

### Don't

- Promoting a brand hue such as clay orange (#d97757, not a system token on this page) to the primary button breaks the thesis that the interface is colorless. The single ink slab at #141413 is the only accent, and color belongs to the collages.
- Adding box-shadows to the 16px announcement cards contradicts a page that measures zero shadows. Lifted cards turn a printed broadsheet into a dashboard.
- Swapping the canvas for pure white (#ffffff, not a system token) strips the yellow cast from #faf9f5. The warm-paper feel collapses into generic SaaS.
- Rounding the Learn more images to 16px to match the cards erases the deliberate 0px plate edge. The illustrations stop reading as printed art.
- Setting paragraphs in #141413 because "black is more readable" flattens the hierarchy. Body copy at #5e5d59 is what lets 22px weight 700 titles stand out without growing.
- Filling the 22px-to-48px gap with 28px, 32px and 36px headings dilutes the deliberate 2.18× leap. The page needs exactly two headline tiers.
- Never set anthropicSerif below 22px or use it for buttons and labels. At 1 of 72 samples it is a hero-only voice, and spreading it turns punctuation into wallpaper.

## Surfaces

| Level | Name | Value | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Paper Canvas | `#faf9f5` | Page ground behind the hero, card grids and the Learn more section |
| 1 | Linen Surface | `#f5f4ed` | Announcement cards, the feature carousel band, nav pills and light inputs |
| 2 | Parchment Fill | `#e8e6dc` | Secondary buttons and meta pills sitting on linen cards |
| 3 | Carbon Panel | `#262624` | Inverted inputs and panels lifted off the ink footer |
| 4 | Ink | `#141413` | The inverted footer field and the primary-button slab |

## Elevation

The system measures zero box-shadows. It is deliberately flat, and depth comes from tonal layering plus hairlines. Each surface sits one warm step darker than the one beneath it: #faf9f5 canvas, #f5f4ed cards, #e8e6dc buttons. Where tone alone is too subtle, a 1px #dedcd1 or #e8e6dc border draws the edge, and on the ink footer 1px #3d3d3a rules take over. The UI feels like stacked sheets of uncoated paper on a desk rather than like floating glass panels, and anything with a drop shadow would read as a foreign object.

## Imagery

Imagery is editorial collage and studio photography. There are no product screenshots and no UI mockups. The feature band shows a single object photographed on black (a transparent practice padlock), framed square at 0px radius. The Learn more tiles are 424px × 530px collages built from engraved architecture, compass roses, grid paper, x-ray nautilus shells and torn landscape paintings, mixed with flat blocks of saturated green, yellow and blue. Those hues are decorative and are not system tokens. No image carries a border, radius or shadow. Icons are thin single-weight line glyphs (chevrons, arrows, a download tray, a magnifier) at caption size in the surrounding text color. There are no gradients, glows or orbs. Taken together, the images tell the story of a scholarly archive that thinks about AI through history, science and craft.

## Layout

Content runs inside a 1920px max-width container with 80px side gutters, which yields a 1745px measure at a 1905px viewport, and lead paragraphs are capped at 616px. Sections stack at an 80px rhythm, broken once by the 224px-padded carousel band. The hero is a left-aligned three-line statement with no image, followed by the full-bleed linen band, a three-column announcement grid, a ruled "Learn more" header and a four-column image-tile row, all with 16px gutters. There is no pricing grid or logo row. Surfaces alternate canvas, linen band, canvas, then the ink footer. The 84px nav is sticky and transparent, with pills left, the wordmark centered and pills plus icons right. The footer runs in three columns: wordmark, accordion and mission. At 375px, use 16px gutters, step the hero down to 22px, keep 48px for short carousel titles and use a 48px section gap. Overall density is comfortable.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #faf9f5 (Paper Canvas)
- card surface: #f5f4ed (Linen Surface)
- secondary fill: #e8e6dc (Parchment Fill)
- primary text: #141413 (Ink)
- body text: #5e5d59 (Slate Caption)
- hairline: #dedcd1 (Sand Border)
- primary action: #141413 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and bars stay neutral-only, built from the ramp #141413, #5e5d59, #87867f, #b0aea5 and #dedcd1 on #faf9f5, with the highlighted series in solid #141413 and comparison series in #87867f. Saturated hue is not used in data, so no visualization outshouts the collage illustrations.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor with background #141413, text #faf9f5, a 1px solid #141413 border, border-radius 10px, padding 12px 24px and a height of 36px, set in anthropicSans (fallback DM Sans) at 17px, weight 400, line-height 1.53, letter-spacing 0px, with no box-shadow. On hover, shift the background to #30302e and keep the border matched to the fill. Place at most one per viewport, and pair it with a secondary button using background #e8e6dc, text #30302e, a 1px #dedcd1 border, the same 10px radius and padding 12px 20px 12px 24px.

2. Build a sticky Navigation Bar 84px tall with a transparent background over a #faf9f5 page, a 1920px max-width container and 80px horizontal padding. Lay it out in three flex zones. On the left, four pills (News, Research, Policy, Commitments), each with background #f5f4ed, text #3d3d3a, a 1px #e8e6dc border, border-radius 9999px, padding 8px 12px 8px 16px, a 28px height and 13px weight 400 anthropicSans with 0.13px letter-spacing, plus a 12px chevron, all separated by 8px gaps. In the center, a 170px × 24px wordmark in #141413. On the right, two more pills followed by two 28px × 28px icon buttons with radius 8px, padding 8px, background #f5f4ed and a 1px #e8e6dc border. Use no shadow and no bottom border.

3. Build an Announcement Card: an article with background #f5f4ed, border-radius 16px, padding 32px, no border and no shadow, placed in a three-column grid with 16px gaps on #faf9f5. Inside it, add a meta row with an 8px gap: a 36px × 18px pill (background #e8e6dc, 1px #dedcd1 border, radius 9999px, three-dot glyph in #30302e), then "Announcements" and a date at 13px weight 400 in #5e5d59 with 0.13px tracking. Below it, add a 22px weight 700 #141413 title with line-height 1.25, 8px below the meta row, then a 15px weight 400 #30302e summary with line-height 1.5. Push two rows to the bottom, each with 16px vertical padding and a 1px #dedcd1 top border, showing a 15px #141413 label on the left and a 15px #87867f value with an arrow on the right. End with a full-width secondary button (background #e8e6dc, text #30302e, 1px #dedcd1 border, radius 10px, padding 12px 20px 12px 24px, 17px weight 400).

4. Build a Hero Statement: a single h1 on #faf9f5 with a 1745px max width, 80px side gutters and 80px of space below. Start the sentence in a span of anthropicSans (fallback DM Sans at 700) at 48px, weight 600, color #141413, and continue the same sentence in anthropicSerif (fallback Source Serif 4 at 400) at 48px, weight 400, color #141413. Use line-height 1.25 and letter-spacing -0.48px on both spans. Add no image, background, border or shadow. The change of typeface mid-sentence is the only emphasis device.

## Color Quarantine

The defining discipline is that the interface owns no hue. All 11 measured colors are warm neutrals between #faf9f5 and #141413, and saturated color lives only inside illustration rectangles cut at 0px radius. Any of the following would break it: a colored link, a tinted badge, a success-green toast, a brand-orange CTA, or a gradient behind the hero. Each turns the collages from art into competition. To extend the system, encode new states through tone and type. An active pill can invert to #141413 with #faf9f5 text, and an error can use a 1px #141413 border with a 13px weight 700 label. When a feature truly needs color, commission an illustration and frame it as a plate rather than adding a token.

## Two-Voice Headline

Hierarchy at the top of the page comes from switching typefaces, not from changing size, weight contrast or color. The hero holds 48px across both voices: anthropicSans weight 600 for the claim and anthropicSerif weight 400 for the explanation, sharing -0.48px tracking and a single baseline. Three things would break it: enlarging the sans clause, coloring it, or splitting the sentence into a headline and a subhead, which is the conventional SaaS pattern. Each of those announces the hierarchy instead of letting the reader hear it. To extend the device, reuse it only for full-sentence statements at 48px, such as a section manifesto or a report cover. It stays out of buttons, labels and anything below 22px.

## Tonal Elevation

Depth is built from paper weights, not light sources. The page measures no shadows. Instead, #faf9f5 to #f5f4ed to #e8e6dc forms a three-step ladder in which each step is roughly 2–5% darker, and 1px #dedcd1 hairlines handle the edges that tone cannot resolve. Adding a shadow, a hover lift with translateY, or a white card on the warm canvas would break it, because each implies a lighting model the system does not have. To extend the ladder, place any new nested surface one step darker than its parent, and use #262624 inside the #141413 footer for the inverted side. If a fourth light step is needed, render it as a hairline-bordered #faf9f5 inset rather than a deeper tone.

## Similar Brands

- **Anthropic** — Shares with Stripe Press a serif-led editorial voice on warm off-white paper with square-cut illustrated plates, though Stripe Press leans further into book typography and lets color into its UI.
- **Anthropic** — Shares with OpenAI a near-monochrome interface where the filled black button is the only emphasis, but swaps OpenAI's cool pure white for the yellowed #faf9f5 and rounds navigation into 9999px pills.
- **Anthropic** — Shares with Aesop a restraint built on warm parchment surfaces, hairline dividers and zero shadows, applied here to research publishing rather than retail.
- **Anthropic** — Shares with Notion an off-white canvas paired with hand-made editorial illustration, but replaces Notion's playful line drawings with archival collage and adds a mid-sentence serif.
- **Anthropic** — Shares with Claude.ai the same warm-neutral ramp and anthropicSans/anthropicSerif pairing, while withholding the clay accent the product interface spends on actions.
